metadataRaw.title: How to Fix Base of Skull Pain FAST
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to instantly relieve neck pain at the base of the skull. All of these exercises can be done at home and require no special equipment.

This video focuses on the suboccipital muscles, which are located in the upper neck at the base of the skull.

When these muscles become tight and irritated, they can contribute to tension headaches, restricted neck movement, stiffness, and pain at the base of the skull.

To help relieve this pain, we’ll go through a simple step-by-step routine that includes self-massage, stretching, and strengthening exercises. These techniques may provide quick relief while also helping prevent the pain from returning.

Each exercise works differently, so go through them all and use the ones that give you the most relief. You may even notice improvement in as little as 30 seconds.

Watch now and start relieving your upper neck and base-of-skull pain!
